## Progress

- Notifications module (`src/Modules/Notifications`): NOTIFICATION / NOTIFICATION_ATTEMPT (status, attempts, backoff, provider reference, short failure code; no message text or address stored), EF filters + RLS, role `medvya_notifications`; Scheduling's outbox is published by `OutboxDispatcher` to `IAppointmentSubscriber`s (at least once, in order); a trigger keeps the tenants that wrote events so the job knows whose scope to enter
- Hangfire on Azure SQL in schema `hangfire` (no Redis/Service Bus): one recurring job publishes each tenant's outbox then sends what is due (confirmation within about a minute); read-only dashboard at `/admin/jobs` only for users listed in `Jobs:DashboardUsers` (nobody by default); jobs off unless `Jobs:Enabled`
- Booking queues a confirmation and the 24 h / 2 h reminders (facility time, quiet hours 21:00-08:00 moved to the end); reschedule/cancel cancels queued messages and sends the right message once (idempotent on the event id); walk-ins get nothing; consent checked at send time through `IReminderConsent` (default denies all until MDV-P1-019 supplies the real one); retries with backoff (1, 5, 30 min) up to 4 tries then Failed; templates en/hi/ar with clinic, date and time only
- Reception sees each message's status on the appointment panel (`GET /v1/appointments/{id}/notifications`, audited, view membership at the facility) and `GET /v1/notifications/delivery` lists per-channel counts and every failure with its code
- Tested on SQL Server (17 tests + signature/auth tests); mutation-checked: consent check removed, DLT template id check removed, cancel-on-change removed, address added to the body
- Left: the real consent source (MDV-P1-019); the SendGrid event webhook parser and its ECDSA signature check (receipts take a normalised body signed with HMAC for now; email goes over SendGrid's SMTP relay); the Hangfire server in its own Worker.Jobs host and its own database user; failed messages on the board and in the notification centre (MDV-P1-034); the install of Hangfire's tables on deploy (MDV-P0-007); per-clinic quiet hours; Hindi and Arabic wording reviewed by a native speaker

## Description

Hangfire server (Worker.Jobs) on PostgreSQL in its own schema/user — no Redis or Service Bus in P1. Email provider: SendGrid (founder decision 20 Oct 2026, free tier) behind the Notifications adapter; Azure Communication Services remains an alternative. Events: booking confirmation, reschedule, cancellation, 24 h and 2 h reminders, leave rebooking. Templates per tenant/language without clinical details. NOTIFICATION and NOTIFICATION_ATTEMPT record provider id, delivery state and retries with backoff; reminders are cancelled when the appointment changes.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Booking triggers a confirmation within 1 minute; reminders are sent at 24 h and 2 h before (facility time), respecting quiet hours and channel consent.
- [ ] **AC2.** Rescheduling or cancelling cancels pending reminders and sends the right message once (idempotency test).
- [ ] **AC3.** Delivery status (queued, sent, delivered, failed, bounced) is stored and visible to reception for each appointment.
- [ ] **AC4.** Failed sends are retried with backoff up to the configured limit and then shown as failed on the board/notification centre.
- [ ] **AC5.** Hangfire dashboard is only reachable by Medvya operations through authenticated admin route; no Redis or Service Bus resources exist in P1 infrastructure.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
